name: Neural Textures
definition: A technique achieving novel view synthesis, scene editing, animation synthesis, or free viewpoint relighting by optimizing a neural texture jointly with a neural renderer. The high-dimensional neural texture is mapped to a simple 3D proxy surface, sampled as in the standard graphics pipeline to produce features, and decoded into an image by the neural renderer.
summary: Neural Textures is a deferred rendering technique that optimizes high-dimensional feature maps on a 3D proxy surface, producing standard physically based textures compatible with traditional renderers.
